verdict.rationale: QuickBooks offers an Intuit Intelligence chat that answers natural-language financial questions ('What’s driving my profit?') and cash-flow forecasting features, plus an official MCP server exposing 145 QBO API tools for building custom AI agents — together these could support an 'afford X' query grounded in live ledger data. However, no evidence shows a live demo or documented answer specifically to affordability-style questions, and the OpenAPI/llms.txt probes failed, so API-grounding for third-party agents is not fully verified.
